data.title: Sertaconazole 2% (cream, lotion)
data.summary: I Antifungals — Azoles · Imidazole with a benzothiophene ring
data.body:
_Topicals · I Antifungals — Azoles_

**Class:** Imidazole with a benzothiophene ring

## Mechanism of action
- Inhibits 14-α-demethylase (fungistatic)
- The benzothiophene ring mimics tryptophan and is inserted into the fungal membrane, making pores → direct fungicidal effect
- Also antibacterial (Gram-positive), anti-inflammatory and antipruritic (inhibits cytokines, activates p38–COX-2–PGE2 pathway)

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Tinea pedis (interdigital) — approved in the USA; tinea corporis/cruris
- Cutaneous candidiasis, pityriasis versicolor, seborrhoeic dermatitis
- Lotion for hairy areas, scalp and large areas

## Dose & formulations
- Twice daily for 4 weeks

## Adverse effects
- Contact dermatitis, burning, dryness (uncommon)

## Contraindications
- Hypersensitivity to imidazoles

## Pregnancy & lactation
Minimal absorption; use if needed.

## Viva points
- Fungistatic + fungicidal (benzothiophene ring)
- Antipruritic and anti-inflammatory — useful in itchy tinea

_Sources: Wolverton 4e ch.42 (azoles — sertaconazole); Khopkar ch.19. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
